title: Vyre module manifest (module API 1)
description: module.json: what a module does, watches, shows, needs and teaches. Module API 1, frozen by ADR 0047 (it finalizes ADR 0033). Keys marked x-status planned are part of module API 1 but not read by the loader yet. Keys marked deprecated keep working and only warn. An unknown key (x-unknown warn) is ignored at load and is a warning from the checker, never a failure, so a module written for a newer minor still loads (ADR 0047 section 8).

vyre.x-message: must be a contract version like "1" or "1.2"
vyre.description: The module contract it is written for: the major, like "1", or "1.2" when it needs something added in minor 2. Required for an added module (ADR 0047 section 8).

description.description: One plain sentence, shown on the install card. Required for an added module.

main.description: The entry file, relative to the module folder. Default index.js.

roles.description: Where it runs: box is the server, local any device's local node, and mac or windows narrow local to one OS. Default ["box"] for an added module. In 0.2 only the Mac has a local node, so windows alone loads nowhere yet.

requires.description: Modules that must be running first: a list of names, or names with a semver range.

replaces.description: Set to this module's own name to stand in for the first-party module of that name. It must register every tool the original declares.

kind.x-message: must be lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 2 to 25 characters

search.x-message: must be one of this module's own tools, like "vault.mentions.search"

resolve.x-message: must be one of this module's own tools, like "vault.mentions.resolve"

mentions.description: What this module offers the # tag picker (built in only): a kind of thing the person can mention, with the tool that searches names and the tool that resolves one pick for a thread. Names only, never a value.

setupTools.x-message: must be a list of tool names like "relay.setup"
setupTools.description: Tools of this module the setup channel may call before the person has signed in. Built in only: an added module that declares it fails to load. The relay reads it to build the setup-channel allowlist.

tools.description: Its tools: a name (the built in grace form, reach anyone) or an object with reach and outward. Added modules use the object form (ADR 0047).

providers.description: Session drivers (ADR 0030). Built in only in 0.2.

items.x-message: must be a relative path to a .json file inside the module

watchers.description: Watcher preset files the module ships. A preset only describes; it never runs code of its own.

connections.description: The tool that returns this module's connection rows for the connections module (docs/design/cohesion.md). One of this module's own tools.

suggest.description: The tool that answers suggest.query for this module, inside a 25 ms deadline. One of this module's own tools.

hooks.description: Harness points this module contributes to, each served by one of its tools. pretool may only tighten a verdict.

senders.description: Deprecated (ADR 0047): mark the tool outward instead. Gate sender types: type name to the tool that sends after the Gate approved.

apps.description: @App adapters: app id to its actions, each served by a tool.

commands.description: CLI verbs: vyre <module> <verb> runs this tool, with positional args taken as these input keys in order.

summary.x-message: must be one lowercase line with no final period

on.description: Event patterns it subscribes to: a type, noun.* or *.

streams.description: WebSocket streams. Built in only in 0.2.

notices.description: Notice kinds it raises, rendered from needs.list by push, the Capsule, the Deck and the phone, instead of a fixed map.

settings.description: Settings in the settings registry's shape. Each key starts with the module's name and a dot.

items.x-message: must be a vault item name, or per-<thing>

vault.description: Raw vault item names. Built in only in 0.2; an added module uses needs.credentials and ctx.vault.request.

connections.description: Vendor-hosted MCP connections it reads through ctx.connections.call (P5, P20).

spend.description: Its default daily cap on core/spend.

tools.description: Tools it calls through ctx.call, or module.* for all of one module's.

items.x-message: must be a host name, optionally *.domain or with a port

credentials.description: What it needs from the Vault, which the vault lists and fills (ADR 0028, 9a). The item is `item`, or <module>-<id>.

item.x-message: must be a vault item name

prompt.description: Prompt layers: markdown files in the module, at account, project or agent level.

file.x-message: must be a relative path to a .md file

tips.description: Short tips the tips module shows on each surface.

id.x-message: must be lowercase letters, digits and dashes

text.x-message: must be 1 to 140 characters with no em dash or section sign

docs.x-message: must be a relative path to a .md file, with an optional #anchor

about.description: What the tip is about (a part of Vyre such as chat, box or modules), for the tips list.

toolEntry.description: One tool: who may call it (reach), whether it acts as the person outside (outward), and whether it spends money (cost).

summary.x-message: must be 1 to 140 characters with no em dash or section sign

reach.description: anyone (default), asked (an agent only when the person's own turn asked), person (reserved for Vyre), modules (other modules only), hook (the webhook route only).

outward.description: It acts as the person outside. The registry runs it from the person's own surface and files every other call at the Gate.

cost.description: It spends money through the module's own model or API use.

target.description: For an asked tool (built in only): an internal tool of this module that answers what one call acts on, so the person's yes binds that thing and not the whole tool.

moduleName.x-message: must be lowercase letters, digits and dashes

word.x-message: must be lowercase letters, digits and dashes

toolPattern.x-message: must look like module.verb or module.*

eventPattern.x-message: must be an event type, noun.* or *

slot.x-message: must be a slot: panel, settings, route, view, now, renderer or slash, optionally :<name>

read.description: A dotted path into the tool's answer that holds the list.

choicesFrom.description: One of this module's own tools that lists the choices when the schema is read, within 500 ms; otherwise the enum or no choices (ADR 0035).

check.description: One of this module's own tools, asked { ok } or { ok: false, message } before a value is stored, within 500 ms; off or late refuses the change (ADR 0035).

secret.description: Its value is masked for anyone but the person (settings maskFor).

labels.description: A label per enum value, for surfaces that list the choices.

security.description: The setting can loosen what Vyre allows; the Deck marks it.

loosens.description: What it loosens, in a few words.

confirm.description: Ask the person before a change: always, or only for these values.

anyOf.description: A list: ask when an entry is taken out.

settingStore.description: Where the value is kept. Omitted: Vyre's settings table.

config.x-message: must be a dotted path into config.json

claude.x-message: must be a dotted path into Claude Code's settings
